opportunities.title: Annual Meeting Grants

amount.raw: Funding is intended to support travel from the applicant’s country of residence in the Global South to the UK and return travel to that country after the meeting.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must be a BES member, you can be at any stage in your research career. Must be a citizen of and based in* the Global South. Must be travelling from and returning to the country you are based in the Global South Must have applied to present at the Annual Meeting (this can include workshops, research presentations, posters, etc). Must be at least three years since you were last awarded a BES Training and Travel Grant.
opportunities.summary: Funding is intended to support travel from the applicant’s country of residence in the Global South to the UK and return travel to that country after the meeting.
